title: RAM↔Window Latency Lock · πHz stream · ITS feel modulate
thesis: Another spot: the tied was LOCK and RESISTANCE. RAM→window has that same latency lock. Stream to monitor at πHz (f=1/π), modulating with emotion / ITS feel.

another_spot.same_as: hard UI freeze / wake-validate unclean cut
another_spot.rule: latency = resistance; lock when resistance × demand > frame budget

lock_resistance.thesis: latency = resistance (electricity-RT). When RAM→window path resistance climbs past frame budget, lock seats — same phenotype as hard UI freeze.
